label: At GO, fires after unrewarded trials, most after a1-rare-S2 losses, more when belief favors S1.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Active only at GO (D1/D2 essentially zero). Magnitude is driven by the previous trial being unrewarded: largest after a1 S2 u (rare-unrewarded after a1, MB stay-on-a1 situation, ~+3.8 residual), moderate after a1 S1 u and a2 S2 u, low after any rewarded trial. Within unrewarded trials it scales with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (a1-favoring evidence). The free fit adds the trial before also being unrewarded (loss streaks push it toward ~4) and separate a1 S1 u / a2 S2 u indicators; rewarded trials suppress it. No future variables used.

issues: Label overgeneralizes 'fires after unrewarded trials': after a2 S1 u the GO residual is -0.78, about the same as after rewarded trials. The belief_lo interaction covers this case (misses residual only +0.15), and the label's 'more when belief favors S1' clause partly signals it.

Loss streaks are under-predicted. The worst dev windows are runs of unrewarded a1 choices with actual ~3.5-4.8 vs predicted ~0-1.9. Adding a two-back-loss term does not help in the short form: replacing the plain prev_reward==0 term with prev_reward==0 * (tv('reward', -2) == 0) gives test 0.647, and replacing the last_is term with it gives 0.637, both below 0.675.
Over-prediction at GO after rewarded a2 trials (-0.68 after a2 S2 r, -0.66 after a2 S1 r). It is modest and the short form has no term for it.

Every claim checks out on the test split. The full short form scores 0.675. Dropping the belief term gives 0.514, dropping last_is('a1 S2 u') gives 0.641, and swapping the interaction for an un-gated belief_lo gives 0.597. The positive belief_lo weight (+0.51) confirms 'more when belief favors S1'.

Using the future/model choice (action == 1) raises the score to 0.724, which suggests the feature tracks an upcoming a1 choice after a loss. This is not allowed in the observed-only form; the recorded short form is the best observed version I found (variants with belief, |belief_lo|, belief_cover or prev_action all scored 0.58-0.678, none clearly better).
